name: shuzhi-gongxiao-mp
description: 数智供销 B2B 供应链+金融平台 微信小程序（uni-app 一套代码 → H5 + 微信小程序）

scripts.build:h5:production: test -n "$VITE_API_BASE" || { echo 'VITE_API_BASE must be an HTTPS production API origin' >&2; exit 1; }; case "$VITE_API_BASE" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'VITE_API_BASE must start with https://' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; uni build
scripts.build:mp-weixin:local: API_HOST="${VITE_API_HOST:-$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null || hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')}"; test -n "$API_HOST" || { echo '无法探测局域网地址，请设置 VITE_API_HOST'; exit 1; }; VITE_API_BASE="${VITE_API_BASE:-http://$API_HOST:8787}" uni build -p mp-weixin
scripts.build:mp-weixin:production: test -n "$VITE_API_BASE" || { echo 'VITE_API_BASE must be an HTTPS production API origin' >&2; exit 1; }; case "$VITE_API_BASE" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'VITE_API_BASE must start with https://' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; uni build -p mp-weixin
